subject: pallas cat
title: This Wild Cat Can't Outrun Its Prey, So It Waits at the Door

scenes.text: This wild cat is too slow to chase its prey. It doesn't need to.
The Pallas's cat lives on cold Asian steppes. It weighs up to five kilos, on short, stubby legs.
It's not built to sprint. So it hunts by ambush, waiting outside burrow entrances.
Its favourite target is the pika, a small cousin of rabbits, often over half its diet.
And it can wait in brutal cold, wrapped in about nine thousand hairs per square centimetre.
The pika comes out. The fluffy cat at the door is already there.

description:
The Pallas's cat, or manul, is a small wild cat of the Asian steppes with short legs, so it hunts by ambush, waiting for prey to appear at burrow entrances.
Pikas can make up more than half its diet, and its fur has about 9,000 hairs per square centimetre for winters as cold as -58 degrees F.
Would you have guessed this cat was a hunter?
first_comment: Unlike most small cats, its pupils are round, not slits. Cute or terrifying, if you were a pika?
